name: GDPR
description: General Data Protection Regulation - EU Data Protection Framework

controls.name: Lawfulness, Fairness, and Transparency
controls.description: Personal data shall be processed lawfully, fairly and in a transparent manner.

controls.name: Purpose Limitation
controls.description: Personal data must be collected for specified, explicit and legitimate purposes.

controls.name: Data Minimization
controls.description: Personal data shall be adequate, relevant and limited to what is necessary.

controls.name: Accuracy
controls.description: Personal data shall be accurate and, where necessary, kept up to date.

controls.name: Storage Limitation
controls.description: Personal data must be kept in a form which permits identification of data subjects for no longer than is necessary.

controls.name: Integrity and Confidentiality
controls.description: Personal data shall be processed in a manner that ensures appropriate security.

controls.name: Lawful Basis for Processing
controls.description: Processing shall be lawful only if and to the extent that at least one of the lawful bases applies.

controls.name: Conditions for Consent
controls.description: Where processing is based on consent, the controller shall be able to demonstrate that consent was given.

controls.name: Information to be Provided - Collection from Data Subject
controls.description: Where personal data are collected from the data subject, the controller shall provide specific information.

controls.name: Right of Access
controls.description: The data subject shall have the right to obtain confirmation as to whether personal data concerning him or her are being processed.

controls.name: Right to Rectification
controls.description: The data subject shall have the right to obtain rectification of inaccurate personal data.

controls.name: Right to Erasure (Right to be Forgotten)
controls.description: The data subject shall have the right to obtain erasure of personal data concerning him or her.

controls.name: Right to Restriction of Processing
controls.description: The data subject shall have the right to obtain restriction of processing.

controls.name: Right to Data Portability
controls.description: The data subject shall have the right to receive personal data in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format.

controls.name: Data Protection by Design and by Default
controls.description: The controller shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures for implementing data protection principles.

controls.name: Records of Processing Activities
controls.description: Each controller and processor shall maintain a record of processing activities under its responsibility.

controls.name: Security of Processing
controls.description: The controller and processor shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure security.

controls.name: Notification of Personal Data Breach
controls.description: In the case of a personal data breach, the controller shall notify the supervisory authority within 72 hours.

controls.name: Data Protection Impact Assessment
controls.description: Where processing is likely to result in a high risk, the controller shall carry out an assessment.

controls.name: Data Protection Officer
controls.description: The controller and processor shall designate a data protection officer in certain circumstances.
